Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot deployment window & procurement checklist

Hi Elena — great conversation this morning, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Summary: We covered use case (real-time customer chat summarization), expected peak QPS (~30), and success KPIs (median latency < 400ms, cost target <$0.001/token).
- Recommended pilot: 2-week proof-of-concept on a dedicated pool (g5-based), sample traffic generator, and a short eval against your latency targets.

Next steps / owners:
1) Procurement: confirm vendor enrollment + W-9 / ACH for billing (Elena / procurement).
2) Technical kickoff: schedule 60-min setup session (Vivek).
3) Contract/terms: hold on SOW while procurement confirms billing flow (Ben).

Proposed window: target start week of May 10th — does that still look feasible on your side? If procurement needs templates, I can loop in Marissa from Sales Ops to share the standard forms.

I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short checklist for procurement to speed things up.

[Attachment: discovery-notes-CloudWave.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,

Hi Procurement team — Vivek from Redwood here. Elena looped you in on our pilot plan. Wanted to check whether you’ve had a chance to create the vendor record and whether there’s anything we should provide to speed the W-9 / ACH process.

Quick TL;DR of what we typically need from customers to complete setup:
- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax form
- ACH form with bank routing and account info (or purchase order for net terms)
- Vendor contact, billing email, and billing address

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can send our standard W-9 and ACH template so you can drop in the details. Would appreciate an ETA so we can lock the May 10 window on our side.

Thanks,
Vivek
